title: Clinical and histological wound healing patterns of collagen-based substitutes: An experimental randomized controlled trial in standardized palatal defects in humans
authors: Bienz SP, Gadzo N, Zuercher AN, Wiedemeier D, Jung RE, Thoma DS. J Clin Periodontol. 2024 Mar;51(3):319-329. doi: 10.1111/jcpe.13903.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Collagen-based wound dressings provide coverage of open defects, albeit without acceleration of wound closure or reduction of pain. FG (which is not intended for open oral wounds) showed slower wound closure compared to C and MD” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
